{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Count QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_count = (sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f'Number of QA orders: {qa_count}')

# Count refunded orders (status == refunded)
refunded_count = (sales['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}')

# Drop QA orders and refunded orders
sales_clean = sales[(sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (sales['status'] == 'completed')].copy()

# Compute conversion rate per customer_segment
conversion_rates = sales_clean.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()
print('\nConversion rates by customer_segment:\n', conversion_rates)

# Identify the segment with highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rates.max()

print(f'\nHighest conversion rate: {best_segment} with {best_rate:.4f}')"}
